shared_elements: animals shown in profile in low relief
quadruped with head and legs rendered schematically
register/panel arrangement of motifs on a rectangular upright slab
framing line or border enclosing the field
justification: Both surfaces show schematic profile animals carved in shallow relief on an upright rectangular slab with a bordered field, and both stack motifs in an upper zone above a lower zone. But A presents a dense multi-register composition of a row of arched forms, a fringed band, felines, birds, snakes and a human-like figure, while B shows only two or three sparse animal figures above a large whirling multi-armed rosette, a motif with no counterpart in A.
